content.statement: The current v2 policy explicitly sets a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, so the claim is supported.
content.plan: Extract the current policy window, the stale retrieved window, the order age, and the judge reference days; compute eligibility under the current window and the discrepancy between the judge reference and current policy. No n/mean/sd fields were present, so a two-sample t-test was not applicable; I used a deterministic policy-consistency computation.

evidence.note: No two-group mean/sd data were provided, so inferential t-test statistics are not computable.
